facts.text: The party must bring metal from the Dwarven mine to Warwick the smith. In exchange he lent them his mithril chain shirt, and he holds the party's plate armor as collateral and keeps Sir Phidipaldi's lyre meanwhile.
Wayman wears Warwick's mithril chain shirt, on loan under the deal. It is Warwick's grandfather's heirloom and halves damage from magic weapons and spells.
A natural-looking cave-in seals the Dwarven mine entrance and blocks getting metal for Warwick. It can be dug through, and Dunk has partly cleared it.
